title: Ms
incidentLocation: Emergency Department, St James's Hospital, Dublin
incidentSummary: I slipped and fell on my outstretched right hand. The emergency department X-rayed my wrist, said it was a sprain and sent me home with no follow-up. The pain did not go away. Weeks later a repeat scan showed a scaphoid fracture that has not healed, and I now need surgery. I have missed exams and shifts at my part-time job.

events.what: Fell on outstretched right hand; St James's Hospital emergency department X-rayed the wrist, said sprain, no follow-up
Repeat imaging showed a scaphoid fracture that has not healed; surgery planned

desiredOutcome: An explanation, an apology, changes to how wrist injuries are checked, and to know whether I can claim compensation
